version: v117 Private Repo First Commit Builder
purpose: Convert the production repo file pack, API error and audit envelope pack, and CI workflow blueprint into a safe first commit plan for the future private PursuitDesk backend repository.

repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Explain alpha scope, local setup, proof commands, privacy rules, and release ritual.

repoShellFiles.label: Root command map
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Define install, dev, lint, typecheck, test, migrate, seed, smoke, and release-gate scripts.

repoShellFiles.label: Monorepo boundary
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Keep apps and packages separated before backend code grows.

repoShellFiles.label: Safety guard
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Exclude node_modules, env files, coverage, local databases, and generated evidence.

repoShellFiles.label: Environment contract
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Name database, session, billing test mode, mail, storage, audit, and app URL keys without secrets.

repoShellFiles.label: Review ownership
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Route platform, backend, database, security, billing, importer, audit, and docs changes to owners.

repoShellFiles.label: PR proof
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Require issue link, commands, artifacts, migrations, screenshots, rollout, and rollback notes.

repoShellFiles.label: Architecture map
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Capture apps, packages, API groups, data model, access model, and deployment boundaries.

repoShellFiles.label: Release ritual
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Record required checks, artifact names, branch rules, owner signoff, and rollback decision.

repoShellFiles.label: Access proof
repoShellFiles.firstResponsibility: Document safe errors, request ids, audit envelope, denied events, redaction, and tenant rules.

appApiFiles.firstResponsibility: Boot app, port, health endpoint, graceful shutdown, and request id.
Connect middleware, routes, error handler, audit context, and tenant scope.

Reject cross-company reads and writes before controller code runs.

Log status, route, actor, tenant, duration, and audit event id without leaking restricted values.

packageFiles.label: Billing shell
packageFiles.firstResponsibility: Keep USD plans, checkout preview, webhook signature, invoices, seats, and access locks in test mode.

workflowFileContents.firstContentRule: Checkout, setup Node, enable pnpm, install, lint, typecheck, unit, contract, route, auth, redaction, migration, billing, audit, and artifact upload jobs.
Prove auth tenant guards, section denials, commercial vault denial, redaction, request id, and audit events.
Apply migrations, seed fixtures, rollback, restore, check count parity, and upload proof.
Run checkout preview, webhook signature, idempotency, invoice lifecycle, and seat sync checks in test mode only.
Run workbook staging, validation, quarantine, duplicate decisions, and rollback id proof.
Run login, records, commercial denial, import dry run, billing test, feedback, audit, and report smoke checks.
Collect required checks, blockers, artifacts, owner signoff, and release decision.
Run dependency review, license check, secret scan, and vulnerable package stop.

handoff: v117 converts the planning stack into a first-commit builder for the future private repo.
The first private commit should contain shell files, docs, API middleware names, package boundaries, env examples, workflow files, and proof commands before feature coding begins.
No secrets or customer data belong in the first commit.
v118 can generate copy-ready GitHub issue bodies so the private repo backlog can be opened with acceptance tests already attached.
